decisionsTitle: A runner entered by hand stands by name in the public ranking once the staff record that they agreed
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-17 (~19:15)**, answering the question the results work raised («a typed runner — a bib no registration holds — is never named on the public page, because no staff member may tick for a runner; a guest who really wants a name there cannot have one. Is that right?»): «ar trebui să-l putem adăuga totuși în sistem manual, chiar dacă e adăugat de mână, să-l punem în rezultat». A runner added by hand («Adaugă un alergător neînscris»: number, name, sex, birth date) must be able to stand **by name** in the public ranking.

**Amends** the decision *Race results, part 1: entered or imported by race number, ranked, published only when the notice says so* (the same batch): that decision refused «a name for a typed runner on the public page (no staff-given consent)» and said a typed runner is never named. It is now named, under the rule below. Everything else in it stands — in particular a **registered** runner's name still follows only their own tick on the form.

**Decision.** The house's rule does not move: a public list is a disclosure, and a name shows only for a person who agreed (§143, §396, `CLAUDE.md`'s unbreakable row). For a registered runner the agreement is their own tick. For a runner typed by hand there is no form, and the house already has the shape for that: the race-day desk's **paper declaration**, which the *participant* signs and a staff member *records*, the audit naming who recorded it (§67, BR-REQ-037-05). So **a typed runner is named in the public ranking only while the staff ticked, on their line, that the person agreed to appear by name — recorded, audited (who, when), off by default; without it «Participant #bib», as before.** The dispatcher's decision, taken on the owner's answer.

**The data** (migration `0167_event_results_name_agreed`, an expand: two nullable columns). `event_results.name_agreed_at` (a timestamp rather than a boolean, so «when» is on the row) and `name_agreed_by_staff_user_id` (`ON DELETE SET NULL`; the audit row names who too). Three checks, all at the database: the mark exists **only on a row no registration holds** (`registration_id IS NULL` — a registered runner's name follows their own tick, never a staff mark, and a typed row a registration later takes over loses it in the same save); a mark needs **a name to show** (`display_name IS NOT NULL`); and the actor is set **only with the moment**. The brief asked that the two be set together; `ON DELETE SET NULL` makes that impossible (removing a staff account must leave the agreement standing, naming nobody), so the check is the one-way form.

**The rule** (`publicResultName`, still the one pure function the page, the backoffice preview and the public read share). It gains `typedNameAgreed` and `typedDisplayName`: a row with **no registration** is named when the mark is set, the typed name is not blank, **and a privacy notice that describes the results is in force** (`firstResultsNoticeVersion` is not null — the person agreed to the words the staff read to them, the notice's own); a registered row ignores the mark entirely. `readPublicEventResults` selects the two columns and passes them; its rows keep their shape (`name | null`), so nothing about the page lane changes, and no agreement, moment or actor ever reaches the public.

**The line.** On each typed line of `/admin/events/[id]/results`, a real tick box (`CheckboxField`, never a toggle button) «A acceptat să apară cu numele în clasament», with «Bifezi doar dacă persoana ți-a spus-o; cine a bifat și când rămân în jurnal.»; it is posted with the line (`n[<i>].agreed`) and comes back as posted after a refusal (§315). A registered line draws none and a forged `r[..].agreed` is ignored. **Who:** every role that may enter results (`canEnterResults`: the Organizer, the Administrator, the Superadministrator), as at the desk a paper declaration is recorded by every staff role; the Tehnic role and the volunteer are refused by the service. **The save** («Salvează tot clasamentul», one transaction) sets `name_agreed_at = now()` and the actor when the tick turns on, clears both when it turns off, and leaves both as they were when it stays on — a correction of the time does not rewrite who recorded the agreement. A tick on a line with no name is a refused row (`agreedNameMissing`, the first invalid row refuses all) with its own sentence; a tick alone on an otherwise empty line is no row. A CSV never carries an agreement, and a number it adds starts a new line unticked (a ticked empty line is never handed to an imported number: the tick would be another person's). The agreement's moment is part of the stored rows' fingerprint, so a form drawn before a colleague ticked or unticked the line is refused with CONFLICT.

**The trail.** `event_result.created` / `.updated` carry `nameAgreed: true|false` when the agreement was recorded or withdrawn (`changed` names `nameAgreed`), under the audit row's actor and moment — **never the name**, the lane's audit rule. A withdrawal is as easy as the recording: the tick comes off and the next read shows «Participant #bib»; the notice also says the agreement can be withdrawn by writing to the club.

**The notice.** The privacy notice template's `{{results}}` paragraph (section 4) also says that a runner who did not register and whose time the organizers entered by hand appears by name only if they told the organizers so (otherwise «Participant #numărul de concurs»), that the organizers record in the log that they agreed, who recorded it and when, and that the agreement can be withdrawn at any time (consent, art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), in both languages. The notice's `{{results}}` merge field, the `resultsNotice` row on `/admin/tasks` and the gate are unchanged: no notice describing the results is in force anywhere yet, so approving the notice once from the new template covers the registered and the typed. **The terms' template is unchanged**: its sentence speaks to people who register («cu numele doar al celor care au bifat…») and a runner entered by hand accepted no terms. **A lawyer reads the new sentence** with the rest of section 4.

**Retention and erasure.** The sweep deletes a race's results three years after the race **whole rows at a time**, so a typed name and its agreement (moment, actor) go together; nothing is cleared on its own. «Toate datele unei persoane» does not read typed rows (no registration) and needs nothing.

**Refused.** A staff mark on a registered runner (their name stays their own tick's); a name shown without a recorded agreement, or while no approved notice describes the results; a tick that carries no name; an agreement in a CSV; a second verb or a new role for it; clearing the name and the agreement as separate steps of the sweep; and showing the public who recorded it or when.
changelogLine: - **A runner entered by hand can stand by name in the ranking** — on «Clasament», a typed runner's line has a tick «A acceptat să apară cu numele în clasament»; ticked by whoever enters results (who and when are kept in the log, never the name), the public ranking shows the typed name, otherwise «Participant #număr»; the privacy notice's template says so (migration `0167`). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a runner the club entered by hand in a race's results (no registration holds the number), when the public read returns the results, then the typed name is shown only while a staff member has recorded on that line that the person agreed to appear by name (`name_agreed_at`), the name is not blank and a privacy notice that describes the results is in force; otherwise the row is «Participant #bib»; a registered runner is named by their own «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate» tick alone and a staff mark on their row means nothing; taking the tick off takes the name off the next read; and the read still carries no agreement, moment, actor, note or registration id (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/public-name.test.ts`, integration `results/typed-name.test.ts`, `results/results.test.ts`.

Given a race's «Clasament» page, when an Organizer or an Administrator ticks «A acceptat să apară cu numele în clasament» on a line of a runner entered by hand and presses «Salvează tot clasamentul», then the moment and the staff member are recorded with the line (left as they were while it stays ticked, cleared when it is taken off), one audit row names the change (`nameAgreed`) and never the name, a registered runner's line has no such tick and a forged one is ignored, a tick on a line with no name refuses the save with its own sentence while every box keeps what was typed (the tick included), a CSV import adds its new lines unticked, a form older than another session's tick is refused with CONFLICT, and the database refuses the mark on a row a registration holds (2026-10-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/typed-name.test.ts`, `results/page.test.ts`, unit `results/row-input.test.ts`, `results/typed-line-recall.test.ts`, `results/rows-and-merge.test.ts`, e2e `race-results.spec.ts`.
